name: github-runner
description: A sandbox that runs GitHub Actions jobs, with the Actions runner and Docker installed.
longDescription: The GitHub Actions runner sandbox ships the Actions runner in /actions-runner, a Docker engine that keeps its data on the /runner volume when there is one, git, Python and build tools on Ubuntu 24.04. Blaxel starts a single-use runner in it for each workflow job that asks for a blaxel- runner label.
